title: Maple Taffy
description: Maple Taffy is a dish from Canada prepared with . This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Crushed clean ice substitutes for fresh snow; candy syrup is scalding and requires care.

steps.instruction: Heat pure maple syrup carefully to about 112–115°C (soft-ball stage) using a candy thermometer; syrup is extremely hot.
Crush clean ice in a shallow tray to mimic packed snow; do not add any new flavorings.
Pour narrow ribbons of hot syrup over crushed ice, let cool briefly and roll onto food-safe sticks; protect hands from burns.
